title: Add visible V4 Stage dependencies and certify clean-reset execution
goal: Make earlier-Stage orchestration explicitly opt-in and visible, then certify every Stage across direct positive, negative and clean-reset cases.
acceptanceCriteria: Direct Stage execution remains the default and reports only the requested Stage.
The optional --with-dependencies switch runs the canonical earlier Stages and reports the exact attempted order.
Dependency orchestration stops at the first structured failure without hiding or inventing Stage execution.
Each of Bootstrap, Analysis, Pre and Post passes positive, blocking, missing-input and post-reset execution tests.
The CLI and Stage result contracts remain strict and hash-bound in the contract manifest.
P0-P3A and current V3 validation remain green with no active workflow or remote change.
